column_description: Full name of the user. may be NULL.
Email address of the user. may be NULL.
Role of the user (e.g., developer, designer, administrator). always exactly one of 'developer', 'designer', 'administrator'. may be NULL.
Hashed password for the user. may be NULL.
Timestamp for when the user was created. may be NULL.
Timestamp for the last update to the user. may be NULL.
Status of the user (e.g., active, suspended). always exactly one of 'active', 'suspended'. may be NULL.
